subject.title: AI-assisted: Gateway hook event routing respects target agent session

question: Should this protected draft be closed as superseded by https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/73228, or refreshed as a separate hook-targeting policy change?
rationale: The central bug is already fixed and shipped, but the current PR is member-authored and maintainer-labeled, and its remaining sessionKey fallback changes a security-sensitive routing policy.

options.title: Close superseded draft
options.body: Close this PR after confirming the merged replacement remains the canonical fix and no unique current-main gap is being preserved here.

options.title: Refresh against current policy
options.body: Rebase the branch and remove the sessionKey-derived fallback so omitted agentId continues to use the default target policy.

options.title: Sponsor sessionKey targeting separately
options.body: Treat sessionKey-based hook target selection as a new explicit policy change with allowlist and security tests rather than incidental bug-fix behavior.

recommendation.title: Close superseded draft
recommendation.body: Close this PR after confirming the merged replacement remains the canonical fix and no unique current-main gap is being preserved here.

likelyOwner.reason: They authored this draft and the merged replacement PR, and are assigned to this protected item.
